title.narrative: Tanzania - Zambia Interconnector

description.narrative: The project is a blended action for co-financing of a transmission line between Tanzania and Zambia. It will construct approximately 620 km of 400 kV double circuit transmission lines, starting in Iringa through Kisada and Mbeya to Tunduma and continuing from Tunduma to Sumbawanga to link the Tanzanian North-West Grid to the interconnector with Zambia. In addition, the project will provide TA to the electricity public utility TANESCO.
